source.name: San Jose Earthquakes – 'NEWS: San Jose Earthquakes and El Camino Health Announce Landmark Community-Focused Partnership'
source.quote: announced today a multi-year partnership that brings together two South Bay organizations with a shared goal of making meaningful impact on community health

note: Multi-year front-of-jersey deal from the 2025 MLS season. End date and value not disclosed; SportsBusiness Journal (2025-01-29) reports the signing but its article is paywalled.
